intro.title: Database operations
intro.body: In this lesson, you will build a simple application that performs basic database operations, such as creating, reading, updating, and deleting data. You will learn the core concept of interacting with a database using structured queries to manage persistent data. The main technologies involved include a database system (like SQLite) and a programming interface (such as a database driver or ORM) to execute operations. By the end, you'll understand how to connect to a database, run queries, and handle data securely and efficiently.
intro.usecase: Database operations are fundamental to virtually every production application that stores and retrieves data. In e-commerce platforms, these operations power product catalogs, shopping carts, and order histories. Content management systems rely on them for creating, updating, and displaying articles or user profiles. Even simple features like user authentication or saving application preferences involve executing queries to read from and write to databases.
